sources.title: FitzMaurice of Kerry, the Carlow account of John
sources.repository: fitzmaurice-family.com, read November 2026.
sources.note: A published family history. It says John was born on 6 July 1803, son of John FitzMaurice of Kelvin Grove, Killeshin, County Carlow, and Henrietta Frances Cary.
